productArea.name: Labels
productArea.scope: Create, edit, delete, and assign repository or organization labels, including their names, colors, descriptions, and list counts. Other issue and pull request controls are outside this area.

entryPoints.directions: Choose Issues then Labels in the seeded repository and manage its labels. Use an issue or pull request sidebar to check assignment.
Open an organization you can access and choose Settings then Labels to manage its shared labels. Create a disposable organization if none exists.
